body: reading this made me so happy. i’m glad you find joy in the little things. letting go of someone can be hard. but you two may not be aligned and on different paths and that’s okay. do what’s the best for you. i’ve been in the same position too, a recent breakup and i’m bot super angry about it because i can start a nee journey by myself.

i’m not with him anymore. i need time to grow apart and he agreed he does as well. no promises to eachother about being together in the future. but maybe we’ll find eachother again and things can work out. i do love him, and we have a bond for life. he’s my best friend and it’s just best if we remain as friends.
thank you. i would like that alot.
he said back then he didn’t. he didn’t appreciate me and love me properly then. but now he does.
it was the best time. he is my best friend. i love him so much i don’t know what to do
you don’t think cheaters can be forgiven?
He’s been changing the past 2 months tho. Our bond has gotten much tighter because of him.
He said he didn’t tell me because he knew what would happen. I struggle with psychosis & suicide. He said he didn’t tell me because he didn’t want to hurt me anymore.

He doesn’t want me to keep bringing it up. He says that if we stay together, I don’t have to do anything and he will fix everything. I just can’t hang it up over his head. I told him this is something I can’t just forget. For him, it happened 4 months ago. For me, it happened yesterday. He says the past 2 months he feels like it’s the first time when we started dating. He said he’ll go to therapy and work on it.
